# Publish gate report: About page

**Going out:** About page copy, Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience. Approver: the policy names no approver, so the user needs to give an explicit yes to the final text.

## Claims check

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "founded in Bristol in 2019" | On policy list. OK. |
| "has become Bristol's favourite tea" | **Unproven.** Superlative with no source. Remove. |
| "a small team of six" | Product facts list includes team size, so fine as written. OK. |
| "every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | On policy list. OK. |
| "We buy from gardens we've visited." | Not on the policy list and not sourced in this chat. It's a sourcing/provenance claim (and implies all gardens). Origins are listed as fine product facts, but "gardens we've visited" is a claim about the team's practice, so I'd confirm it. Marked `[PROOF NEEDED: confirmation the team has visited every garden it buys from]`. |

## Regulated claims
No health, money, legal, children or price content. The only environmental-adjacent point is none. Pass.

## House style
Mostly plain and specific. "has become Bristol's favourite tea" is a puffed-up stock line, which goes with the fix above. Score about 85 once that is removed.

## Disclosure
Nothing paid, affiliate or AI-labelled here. Pass.

## Fixed (suggested text)
> Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019. We're a small team of six, and every tin is packed by hand in Bristol. [We buy from gardens we've visited. — keep only if true of every garden]

- Removed "has become Bristol's favourite tea" (unproven superlative).

## Needs a decision
1. Is it true that you've visited every garden you buy from? If yes, keep it. If only some, say "We buy from gardens we've visited" → "We've visited many of the gardens we buy from" (only if accurate).
2. Approval: please confirm a named person approves the final text above.

Not publishing until the draft is changed and approved.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "has become Bristol's favourite tea", "type": "superlative"}, {"quote": "We buy from gardens we've visited.", "type": "other"}], "publish": false}
```
